title: Get FASTER ON iRacing OVALS! | iRacing Track Guide | New Hampshire NASCAR GEN 6

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: aim for the first row of dotted white lines, brake early
corners.line: hook the white line through the corner
corners.exit: give it a bit of gas to get the back end rotated, ease back onto throttle
corners.mistakes: aiming for the flat will shoot you up the track

corners.label: T3
corners.mistakes: sliding up the track a bit

corners.line: aim further down the track on exit
corners.exit: ease back on the throttle as you Arc out towards the wall
corners.mistakes: watch out for the bumps in the center of the corner

general_tips: use your first lap as your warm-up lap
run a bit deeper into the corners, give it some extra brake
alternate between the gas and brake with each swerve to build heat in your brakes
run at the bottom of the banked portion of the track and give the tires time to heat up
hook the white lines with your left front and avoid kicking the back end out on exit
use the dotted white lines as a reference point
use the flat portion of the track to gain time on Entry but if you don't get the car rotated you will slide up the track ruin your right front tire and potentially cause a wreck
